Hi! I have included links and instructions to my sessions below. Please feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions.

## Course Modules

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Sessions I

- [**Software Tools**](software/index.qmd)
  <br>*Data interoperability, R-Mplus integration, AI-assisted analysis*

- [**Missing Data**](missing/index.qmd)
  <br>*MCAR, MAR, MNAR, multiple imputation, FIML*

- [**Monte Carlo Simulation**](montecarlo/index.qmd)
  <br>*Power analysis, parameter recovery, simulation studies*
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Sessions II

- [**Multilevel Models**](multilevel/index.qmd)
  <br>*Random effects models, nested data structures*

- [**Dyadic Data Analysis**](dyadic/index.qmd)
  <br>*Actor-Partner Interdependence Model, distinguishable dyads*

- [**Causal Inference**](causal/index.qmd)
  <br>*Observational studies, propensity scores, difference in differences*
:::

:::
